data.title: 1H 2025 Transparency Report Statistics
data.content:
Kakao has not provided communication user information since the first half of 2013.

In response to requests for data on communication-restricting measures in Daum services, only data that strictly pertain to standards are provided after thorough review is conducted in accordance to relevant legislations. We do not provide any data on communication-restricting measures that pertain to Kakao services.

The number of communication confirmation data requests and processed requests related to Daum services increased by 1.7% and decreased by 6%, respectively, compared to the second half of 2024, while those for Kakao services increased by 12.5% and 10.5%, respectively, over the same period.

Requests for search and seizure warrants related to Daum services increased by 17.6% compared to the second half of 2024, while those for Kakao services decreased by 15.2% over the same period.

Kakao strives to provide only the minimum information necessary to meet the requirements.
